items.title: De De Pierce Interview, 1960-01-10
items.q: I was on the street and one of the boys in the band, John Cashmore, I worked with him a lot, playing that play.

ctx.x: Oh, there'll be some time in the day. I saw when she was really shaking today. Oh man. Old woman about 70 years old and she was out there shaking just like she was a kid again.

Well, I'll tell you Dick something that happened to me. Billy and I. Billy had made a spell of sickness. I knew Billy was sick and I knew it wasn't our habits of falling, making second line. And I was playing somewhere in town, I'll just forget the job we had. I was on the street and one of the boys in the band, John Cashmore, I worked with him a lot, playing that play.

items.title: Billie Pierce, De De Pierce, Israel Gorman, Joseph "Kid Twat" Butler Interview, 1963-11-20

ctx.x: Yeah, and whose band was that?
Cassie. The Young Tuxedo. The Young Tuxedo. Oh, I see. What are some of the other dance bands you played with?
